profile.summary: A charter bus company based in San Francisco that provides group transportation around the Bay Area. It offers buses and vans for school field trips, athletic team travel, college tours, corporate events and special occasions. It describes its buses and drivers as SPAB-certified, meaning approved for California school pupil activity bus service.

review.notes: Exact name match, San Francisco location (696 Amador St) matches the agenda, and the company advertises SPAB-certified school bus service matching the SPAB transportation agreement. Summary, contact details and address are all supported by the cited pages; the site does not mention OUSD directly, but name, city and service together make identity solid.
